summary: Internal links must use :ref:, either plain or with custom link text.
questions: How do I link to another page in the Ansible docs?
How do I set custom text for an internal link?

answer_card.title: Adding internal links
answer_card.answer_md:
```rst
:ref:`unique_page`
:ref:`this page <unique_page>`
```
The second form sets custom link text.
